verdict.rationale: E2B documents official SDKs in both JavaScript and Python. The quickstart builds on `Sandbox.create()`, `runCode`, and `files.list`, and the docs cover `files.write/read`, `commands.run`, and `setTimeout`/`set_timeout`. There is also a separate Desktop SDK and an explicit `E2B` client for multi-key, BYOC, or self-hosted setups. A community comment independently confirms Python support. Missing for 10: hands-on independent corroboration of SDK quality and a dedicated SDK reference listing supported languages and package names.
